about.heading:
Tucked Away in One of
the World's Most
Beautiful Islands
about.body1: Nestled in St. Vincent and the Grenadines, one of the last unspoiled corners of the Caribbean, Stonetrail Villas offers a serene escape that blends opulence with tranquility.
about.body2: Explore the islands through private lounges and curated excursions, indulge in relaxation, and savour exquisite cuisine with breathtaking views. Top-notch Caribbean hospitality through personalised butler service combined with breathtaking nature — promising a tranquil and luxurious experience like no other.

promises.heading:
All the Essentials for a
Cosy and Comfortable Stay

items.title: Maid Service
items.desc: Your dedicated Stonetrail maid service ensures every request is met with efficiency, warmth, and a personal touch — from arrival to departure.

items.title: Curated Experiences
items.desc: Private sailing, volcanic hikes, island-hopping, and spa treatments — our concierge crafts bespoke itineraries for every guest.

items.title: Privacy is Priority
items.desc: Each villa is a secluded sanctuary designed for quiet solitude. Your hideaway promises comfort, seclusion, and absolute peace.

items.title: Culinary Excellence
items.desc: Savour locally-caught seafood, tropical produce, and Caribbean-inspired cuisine — served in your villa or at our private dining terrace.

items.title: Seamless Transfers
items.desc: From Argyle Airport straight to your villa — and on to hidden beaches and exclusive lounges only our guests can enjoy.

items.title: In-Villa Amenities
items.desc: Every villa is stocked with premium coffee, fine teas, and a complimentary welcome bar to begin your stay in style.
